## 1. Overview

This document links the iOS implementation of `{Module}` to the product documentation it realizes. It is a reference map, not a design document and not a coding guide.

**Module**: `ios-app/Features/{Module}/`
**Implements**: the iOS-target processes of one or more features, plus SwiftUI views, navigation, and platform integration.

## 2. Scope

This module implements:

- The processes whose **Target** is *iOS* in section 3 of the referenced FEATURE-MOBILE documents
- The screens, widgets, and navigation assigned to iOS in the Epic DESIGN

Out of scope:

- Business logic — it lives in `constructor-sdk/feature/{miniapp}/`, see `IMPL-KMP`
- Android UI — see `IMPL-ANDROID`
- Design-system component definitions — see the platform design system

## 6. Code Markers

Traceability Mode FULL uses scope and block markers from `{cf-studio-path}/.core/architecture/specs/traceability.md`:

```swift
// @cpt-algo:cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-algo-{feature-slug}-ios:p1
struct {Feature}View: View {
    @StateObject private var viewModel: {Feature}ViewModelWrapper

    var body: some View {
        // @cpt-begin:cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-algo-{feature-slug}-ios:p1:inst-ios-1
        // one CDSL instruction
        // @cpt-end:cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-algo-{feature-slug}-ios:p1:inst-ios-1
    }
}
```

In DOCS-ONLY mode use `@cpt-impl cpt-{hierarchy-prefix}-{kind}-{slug}` instead.

---

## 7. KMP Integration

The shared ViewModel is consumed through a bridge; it is never reimplemented in Swift.

```swift
final class {Feature}ViewModelWrapper: ObservableObject {
    private let shared: {Feature}ViewModel
    @Published var state: {Feature}State

    func send(_ intent: {Feature}Intent) {
        shared.processIntent(intent: intent)
    }
}
```

## 9. Validation

```bash
cfs validate --artifact ios-app/Features/{Module}/
xcodebuild -scheme ConstructorApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15' build
xcodebuild test -scheme ConstructorApp -destination 'platform=iOS Simulator,name=iPhone 15'
swiftlint
```

Verifies that every iOS-target process has code markers, every marker references a valid design ID, and coverage meets the project threshold.
